nom: The Face Shop Rice Water Bright Rice Bran Gentle Exfoliating Cleanser

segments.sensitive: Multiple reviewers with self-described sensitive skin report the exfoliation as gentle and non-irritating, though one notes it burns her eyes and one found the fragrance irritating.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the cleanser does not strip or over-dry, leaving skin soft, hydrated and not tight.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying combination (sensitive/comb) skin reports it cleans effectively and leaves skin soft.
segments.mature: No specific mature-skin reports beyond general brightening claims are present in sufficient detail to segment.

concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say their skin feels hydrated, soft and not dry or tight after use; one reviewer did note her face felt a little tight after washing.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with rosacea reports the cleanser was gentle and did not strip her skin, with no irritation noted.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the cleanser as non-stripping and non-drying, leaving skin feeling clean without damaging it; one reviewer's skin still felt tight afterward.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with dark spots, acne scars, or hyperpigmentation report visible brightening and fading of marks over a few weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no breakouts or purging, including one who specifically noted no reaction on first use; however one reviewer reports breaking out more than with her prior product and another mentions a small amount of purging.

extraits.texte: I absolutely loved the smell and texture of this product. It went on creamy but definitely had some texture that was great for exfoliation. The only reason I gave it a 3 was because it did have a lot of unrecognizable ingredients and i like to have minimally made beauty products. Also, I did break out more with this product compared to my prior one.

Thank you BZzagent and The Face Shop for this gifting me this product in exchange for my honest review. I have never heard of this brand previously and I am pleasantly surprised by the performance of this product. I have rosacea so I'm usually skeptical skeptical of any exfoliating wash but this foam cleanser uses rice and rice bran extract creating a super gentle experience. It removed my makeup with ease and did not leave my face feeling stripped. I'm impressed.

The hype is real! I had heard about the benefits of rice water all over the internet! I have hyper pigmentation and I can see my skin getting brighter and the marks fading. It leaves my skin hydrated while removing the dead skin! i can't wait to try the other products in the line

This is the most gentle exfoliant facial cleanser I've ever used. I have sensitive and comb skin. It actually did a great job on cleaning. My skin feels so soft and refreshing after every wash. The smell is very pleasant. My new favorite cleanser now!

This is by far my new favorite cleanser. The tiniest amount goes so far! I mean pea size is more than enough. It doesn't dry my skin out or break it out and I have very sensitive skin. Highly recommend!

extraits.titre: I would definitely buy this cleanser !
extraits.texte: The Face Shop sent me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program and I'm so glad I was able to try it out! This face wash was different from other face washes I've tried because it didn't break me out during my first use. Normally I would have some reaction but this one didn't cause any reaction for me. The texture is a very thick and creamy texture but it suds up very well. It wasn't too drying but my face did feel a little tight after washing. What's great is the exfoliation isn't too harsh it's the perfect level of physical exfoliation that I feel wouldn't be damaging to the skin. Just from the creamy texture, how it wasn't irritating, and the potential benefits to brighten the skin and keep it smooth, I would definitely purchase this face wash and recommend that others try it. Also it smells really nice , not like a perfume scent just a creamy fresh sent, but more creamy. I will continue to use it as it has proven to be a quality product thus far!

I really liked the Rice water exfoliating cleanser! It has tiny granuals in it that make exfoliation not too rough but a perfect amount. My skin doesn't real tight or extra dry with this as well which is a plus. The only thing I didn't like was the fragrance, but even then it wasn't too bad just a light soapy vanilla. The lather was nice as well, it was foamy and creamy which feels lux. But I do have sensitive skin and don't love fragrance in skincare. Overall I really liked it!
